sections.description: Royal SMTP is a 100% FREE, powerful WordPress SMTP mailer plugin with email logging, queue system, SweetAlert2 alerts, auto-updates, and instant presets for Gmail, Zoho Mail, Zoho ZeptoMail, Outlook, SendGrid, and custom SMTP servers without extra plugins.
sections.changelog: • 26.01.19: GitHub Releases & WordPress Auto-Update integration. Added Zoho ZeptoMail auto-connect preset with prefilled credentials. Enhanced direct connection support for Gmail and Zoho Mail without 3rd party plugins. 100% Free & Open Source branding.
